تستحفظن (form X)
# تَسْتَحْفِظْنَ (tastaḥfiẓna) /tas.taħ.fiðˤ.na/: second-person feminine plural non-past active indicative/subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَحْفَظَ (istaḥfaẓa)
# تُسْتَحْفَظْنَ (tustaḥfaẓna) /tus.taħ.faðˤ.na/: second-person feminine plural non-past passive indicative/subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَحْفَظَ (istaḥfaẓa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
